<issue_description>
A use-of-uninitialized/invalid-memory read in Array.prototype.join causes a crash: njs_array_prototype_join passes an invalid/uninitialized string value into the buffer append code, triggering a read from an invalid address inside njs_chb_append0 (njs_chb.c).
